description: Pre-execution market regime for one asset (SOL by default, or BTC or ETH with asset): 4-venue composite mid (Coinbase, Kraken, Bitstamp, Binance.us), venue spread, fast-vs-slow venue lead-lag over 15 s and 60 s in bps, Coinbase-only 60-minute Parkinson realized volatility (null when Coinbase bars are unavailable, never a thinner venue), and a calm, elevated or storm regime with a halt flag and a recommended edge add-on to check before an order is placed
name: crypto__sol_regime
